title: Keyboard shortcut remapping doesn't work after pressing calculator keyboard key

status.label: Retest the calculator-key trigger on current stable
status.detail: On an HP Omen 15, pressing the dedicated calculator key reportedly disables Alt+Q-to-Alt+F4; the report and confirmation are from PowerToys 0.74.0/0.85.1 era.

judgment.rationale: The reporter says Alt+Q-to-Alt+F4 stops closing the focused window after pressing the dedicated calculator key on an HP Omen 15, and confirmed the trigger on PowerToys 0.85.1. An older issue #15555 contains the same report from 0.53.3 but was closed for lack of author follow-up, not as a duplicate or fixed issue, so it does not provide active coverage. Ask whether the exact sequence still reproduces on v0.102.3001 and whether restarting Keyboard Manager restores the shortcut.
evidence: The original report lists PowerToys 0.74.0 and an HP Omen 15 with a dedicated calculator key.
The mapping is Alt+Q to Alt+F4; after pressing the calculator key, Alt+Q reportedly stops closing the focused window.
The reporter confirmed the same trigger in a 2024 comment and named the HP Omen 15 en000xxx model.
Open #15555 contains the same 0.53.3 report but was closed after an unanswered request for a v0.73 retest; it is not recorded as a duplicate or fixed.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the calculator-key trigger still breaks Alt+Q-to-Alt+F4 on v0.102.3001 and whether restarting Keyboard Manager restores it.

fix_assessment.rationale: The latest reporter confirmation is from PowerToys 0.85.1; current behavior has not been tested, and the older identical issue #15555 was closed for inactivity rather than resolved.

comment.body: Thanks for confirming the dedicated calculator-key trigger on your HP Omen 15 and giving the Alt+Q-to-Alt+F4 mapping. Since the latest confirmation is from PowerToys 0.85.1, could you retest on v0.102.3001 and say whether pressing that key still breaks the shortcut, and whether restarting Keyboard Manager restores it? The older matching report #15555 was closed for inactivity, not as fixed.
